result.title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
result.comment: Project page and code are available at https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/FL4N/
result.summary: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FL4N，一个前馈式 latent 4D 新视角合成模型：用统一的时空 latent 表示编码 4D 场景先验，在预训练静态 latent 先验之上以残差方式学习时序动态，并用轻量动态编码器从静态特征中解耦物体运动与相机引起的视差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「静态 latent 先验＋动态残差」的前馈状态更新与时间／视点解耦设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的增量更新、以及任务相关视觉信息与无关变化的分离提供可核查的结构线索，但论文本身是渲染任务而非推理研究。
